message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and I found myself fumbling around for our trusty old flashlights. After I got them lit, I realized how nice it was to sit in the soft glow of lanterns instead of staring at screens. We pulled out a deck of cards and spent the evening playing games and sharing stories—no distractions, just good old-fashioned fun. 

It reminded me how these moments can be a great way to reconnect with each other, free from the usual hustle and bustle! 

So, if the lights go out, don’t forget to embrace the low-tech joys of life. What’s your favorite way to keep the fun alive during a power outage? 💡
